- Check the weather forecast before departure

### Hawaii Packing Tips
- Pack lightweight clothing that can be easily mixed and matched

- Bring a refillable water bottle to reduce plastic waste
- Don't forget sunscreen and insect repellent
- Hawaii has strict rules about reef-safe sunscreen
